title: Canonical data for the ordered affine transpose and projection
statement: Fix the finite-coefficient purity setting and the ordered affine comparison [def-pur-affine-space-comparison]. On the ordinary finite-coefficient pro-etale derived categories define the unit presentation unitEtaleIso and unitPlus; compact is identity at zero and standing compact support at positive dimension; counit is the normalized identity or the standing exceptional counit. The transpose is compact.map(Γ_d,K) followed by counit. The ordered coefficient tate, canonical tensor reassociations powerIso/sourceIso, unitPull and tateSourceIso identify the source with pulled-back K tensor T_d and identify F_d(A) with T_d. Integration is compact.map(tateSourceIso.inv) followed by transpose at unitPlus. Projection is the right unitor at zero and, at positive dimension, the specified coefficient-first canonical compactification projection followed by compact.map(sourceIso.inv); projectionInverse inverts exactly this map under an IsIso proof. fixedSourceTransport is the actual proper/open comparison and ordinary compactification comparison; lineUnitSourceIso and lineNormalizedIntegration use these canonical transports and the recorded normalized affine-line trace. BlockLaw denotes the explicit pasted-counit equation for consecutive blocks, universally over the retained finite-Tor etale representative of F_b(K). These are the original concrete constructions, with no new choice or theorem asserted.
